title: A finite-control compiler reports subset fault-path bounds under a shared bath
status_authority: Selected source bytes and producer-reported internal reviews are preserved. This integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority or practical advantage.
reported_status: The Ultra checkpoint reports a bounded finite-key Pauli-control construction around native interaction windows and a subset fault-path theorem for disjoint patches sharing an arbitrary persistent finite bath. Root reports internal reconstruction of key proof steps; external review is absent.
scientific_scope_status: For the supplied local interaction windows and shared-bath model, the ideal-control theorem decomposes the joint evolution into Pauli-key sectors and bounds selected joint-fault sectors using local integrated interaction strengths, without a bath-dimension or volume factor. A finite key-error ledger is charged separately.
